preview.configured: Branch or group from the plugin configuration
preview.note: Placeholder. In the shop RatingStar draws the seal.

variant.label: Variant
variant.helpText: Round seal and banner seal work on every plan. The live widgets from the profile card to the footer bar are available from the 4-Star plan; below that RatingStar shows the banner seal instead.

renderMode.label: Output
renderMode.helpText: The static image needs no JavaScript and links to your profile. It exists for the round seal, the banner seal and the profile card only.

position.label: Position of the profile card
position.helpText: "At this place" puts the card into the content. The four corners make it float at the edge of the screen.

slug.label: Branch (profile slug)
slug.helpText: Fill in only if this seal should show a different branch than the one in the plugin configuration: the part after /t/ in the address of the profile.

group.label: Group (group slug)
group.helpText: Fill in only if this seal should show a group across all its branches: the part after /g/ in the address of the group profile. A group takes precedence over the branch.

award.label: Award instead of the seal (optional)
award.helpText: Shows the image of an award of the branch instead of the seal. Format: type, hyphen, level, as in the image address of the award in RatingStar. Groups have no awards.

dataAttributes.label: Additional data attributes
dataAttributes.helpText: Further attributes for this seal, for example copied from the code generator in RatingStar. They take precedence over the fields above. Only names starting with data- are allowed; profile, group, variant and position have their own fields.

apiKey.label: API key for this page
apiKey.helpText: Fill in only if this page stands for a different branch or group than the rest of the shop, for example a location page. The page then gets the structured data of this key instead of the shop's. There is only ever one block per page.

noRichSnippet.label: Structured data by the seal
noRichSnippet.helpText: If the shop prints the stars for Google itself, the seal leaves out its own output automatically. Choose "Never" if the page already carries structured review data by other means.

pcMobile.label: Floating card on smartphones
pcMobile.helpText: Applies below a screen width of 640 pixels and to the floating card only.

values.overlay: Open the review preview on the page

barShowVerified.label: Show the "Verified" note
barShowVerified.helpText: The note only appears when all counted reviews are confirmed. It can be hidden here, not forced.

heroShowVerified.label: Show the "Verified" note
heroShowVerified.helpText: The note only appears when all counted reviews are confirmed. It can be hidden here, not forced.

heroShowBranches.label: Show the rating of each branch
heroShowBranches.helpText: Only has an effect on a group seal.

values.fixed: Fixed to the bottom of the screen
values.inline: At this place in the page flow

theme.label: Light or dark version
theme.helpText: The dark version adapts the widget to dark page backgrounds.

check.nothing: There is nothing to check yet: enter a branch, a group or an API key.

domain.title: Approve your domain
domain.text: For the live seals: enter the domain of this shop in RatingStar under "Siegel & Widgets → Domains & Statistik", section "Freigegebene Domains", and confirm it with the DNS record TXT _ratingstar.your-domain.com. As soon as a first domain is confirmed there, RatingStar delivers the seal data to confirmed domains only; on others the seal stays empty. A group seal has its own list in the backend of the group, also under "Siegel & Widgets → Domains & Statistik". The shop server fetches the stars for Google with the API key; that is not affected by the approval and possible on every plan.

privacy.title: Privacy and consent
privacy.text: The live seals load seal.js, seal.css, the review data and a counting pixel from the RatingStar server (default: ratingstar.de). The browser of your visitors connects to that server for this. Name it in your privacy policy and take it into account in your consent tool. The stars for Google, by contrast, are fetched by your shop server: no connection from the browser to RatingStar is made for them. The static image loads a single image file only.
